segments.text: This is People O S. A working people operations system, designed and built by Alloyce Amos.
The workspace connects forty eight fictional employees across thirteen countries. Every metric comes from the actual sample records.
The migration hub makes data quality visible. Each exception shows the original value, validation rule, and proposed correction.
Before data moves, the migration lab parses a C S V and checks its fields. This preview makes no employee changes.
The agent studio coordinates specialist tools. Run validation to extract, map, check, and reconcile the source records.
Every step has an inspectable result. These are executed checks, with optional A I explanations, and a clear human approval gate.
Review the proposed changes, then approve. Sixteen corrections are applied, and data quality reaches one hundred percent.
A separate service workflow classifies requests and proposes responsible teams. Onboarding and payroll readiness have their own coordinators.
The people copilot offers text and browser voice, with English and French responses. Example policies and references stay visible.
The audit trail records the result. Explore the live demo, inspect the workflow, and see the engineering behind the interface.
